'''Tarabba Prime''' was a celestial body<ref name="CV16">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'', 2016 edition]]</ref> located in the [[Tarabba system]], a part of the [[Tarabba sector/Legends|Tarabba sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was located on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], which linked it to the [[Denab system/Legends|Denab]]<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Tantra system/Legends|Tantra systems]].<ref name="Tantra">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'' places the [[Tantra system/Legends|Tantra system]], which {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} establishes to have been a part of the [[Tantra sector/Legends|Tantra sector]], [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] from the [[Adarlon system/Legends|Adarlon system]] on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. {{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} further depicts the Rimma Trade Route traveling through, in Coreward direction, from the Adarlon [[Star system/Legends|system]] through the Tantra [[Sector/Legends|sector]] before reaching the [[Tarabba system]], meaning that the Tantra system was situated between the Tarabba and Adarlon systems.</ref>

Tarabba Prime was a major shipping and communications hub that was the nearest such location to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].<ref name="CV16" /> Situated near the edge of the Tarabba [[Sector/Legends|sector]],<ref name="Outer">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Tarabba system|Tarabba]] and [[Utapau system/Legends|Utapau systems]]</ref> the former lay at a considerable distance from Utapau,<ref name="CV16" /> which was situated near the sector's center.<ref name="Outer" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tarabba Prime was first mentioned in the [[2005]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' by [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="ROTSICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Tarabba [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Tarabba Prime, in grid square M-19.<ref name="TEA" />
